feedback: Iteration 0: no earlier race exists, so this feedback rests on the contract and on what I had to set in the controller, not on measured performance; no result is claimed for the current candidate. What I had to compensate for: with a 25 mm tape and 12 mm sensors at 10 mm spacing across 4 cm, only two or three sensors see the tape at once, so the signal is coarse near the centre and I scaled the weights to -1 to +1 with kp = 3 to keep the correction moderate. The 5 cm forward offset means the controller sees the line about 0.05 m before the axle, which should help on bends but may add lag, so I kept kd small at 0.2 to limit overshoot. Next race decision rules: (1) If steering_oscillation is high or max_error grows on the S-bend, move the sensors back toward y = 0.03 (reduce lag) or narrow the sensor span to x = -0.015 to +0.015 to reduce over-steering. (2) If line_loss_events occur on the tightest bend, widen the sensor span to x = -0.03 to +0.03 (the sensor spacing would need to be 15 mm to keep five sensors) or raise sensor_size to 0.016 so the outer sensors keep a reading. (3) If the robot completes but progress is slow (completion_time close to 3 s) or wheels slip on starts, reduce mass to 0.7 or increase wheel_track to 0.14 for more turn authority without slip. Requested changes are listed below and should be tested one at a time where possible.
requested_changes: Test sensor span: if line_loss_events > 0 on the tightest bend, widen sensor x positions to -0.03 .. +0.03 (15 mm spacing) with sensor_size 0.016; this gives outer sensors a reading when the line moves toward them. Basis: no race yet; this is a hypothesis from the 4 cm span limiting the tape visibility.

Test forward offset: if steering_oscillation or max_error is high on the s-bend, move all sensor y from 0.05 to 0.03 to cut the sensor-to-axle lag. Keep x spacing unchanged so only one change is tested.

Test turn authority and mass: if completion_time is near 3 s without line loss, reduce mass from 0.8 to 0.7 kg; if wheel slip or overshoot appears at start, increase wheel_track from 0.12 to 0.14 m. Basis: no race yet; this is a design prior from the contract's speed and turn-rate limits.
